name: ecotrack
description: EcoTrack - Smart Building Energy Management System

scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "AI,BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,green,cyan" "python -m uvicorn src.main:app --app-dir ai-service --reload --port 8000" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:docker: docker compose up -d db && npm run dev
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && pip install -r ai-service/requirements.txt -r ai-service/requirements-experiments.txt
